name: Steal Underwater Eggs
desc:
🥚 Welcome to Mount A Fish

How to play:
🐟 Ride A Fish 
🦈 Steal eggs from the sea monsters across 9 underwater worlds
🏊 Swim back to the beach before the boss catches you!
💰 Earn money with the pets in your aquarium
⬆️ Upgrade your tank to swim faster
🌊 Watch out for the tsunami!
✨ Discover rarer eggs, giant sizes, and Divine, Eternal and Secret pets!

🎮 Supports desktop, console, mobile and tablet players
